title: Vermont place dossier gains Essex Junction and Williston planning context
summary: Two June 2025 regional planning documents distinguish municipality-specific GlobalFoundries property contexts. The September 25 follow-up preserves the earlier Burlington-label and Essex Junction-address note and keeps draft planning maps separate from verified parcel boundaries or current zoning decisions.
evidence_note: The June 1 CCRPC memo hosted by Williston was visually inspected on physical pages 1-4; its filename contains a separate June 3 date. All five pages of the June 23 Essex Junction draft recommendation were visually inspected, including the draft planning map and its survey/zoning disclaimer. The records supply historical planning context, not a verified campus polygon, a later adoption decision or a production outcome.
publication_effect: A dated follow-up appears on the existing Vermont dossier, its three explicitly related readings and their hub cards, with source locations and limitations in the existing JSON export. All ten original September 22 notes, original Phase 178 records, routes and selected article payloads remain unchanged. Canonical identity, independent review, accepted portfolio counts, hosted publication and launch are not supplied by this source check.
